grading_policy: Grade answers independently against the fixed corrected key. Correct requires requested material rulings resolved without material contradiction; partial records omissions/ambiguity, incorrect records material wrong rulings. Equivalent wording accepted. No requested fact is supplied from another answer; unrequested contextual details from the key are not prerequisites. Reader support labels are not grades. Source-unresolved answers cannot receive unconditional core PASS.
